title: Physics
description: Forces, energy, motion, electricity, waves and units.

questions.text: What is the SI unit of force?
questions.explanation: One newton accelerates 1 kg at 1 m/s².

questions.text: Which formula is Newton's second law?
questions.explanation: Net force equals mass times acceleration.

questions.text: What is the acceleration due to gravity near the Earth's surface?
questions.explanation: Near the surface objects in free fall speed up by about 9.8 m/s every second.

questions.text: What is the formula for kinetic energy?
questions.explanation: Kinetic energy grows with the square of speed: ½ m v².

questions.text: What is the SI unit of energy?
questions.explanation: Energy and work are measured in joules.

questions.text: Which equation is Ohm's law?
questions.explanation: Voltage equals current times resistance.

questions.text: One watt is equal to:
questions.explanation: Power is energy per unit time.

questions.text: Which of these is a vector quantity?
questions.explanation: Velocity has both size and direction; speed has only size.

questions.text: What is the approximate speed of sound in air at room temperature?
questions.explanation: Sound travels about 343 m/s in air; about 1,500 m/s is its speed in water.

questions.text: A car travels 120 km in 2 hours. What is its average speed?
questions.explanation: Average speed = distance / time = 120 km / 2 h = 60 km/h.

questions.text: What does Newton's third law say?
choices: Every action has an equal and opposite reaction
An object at rest stays at rest unless a force acts on it
Energy cannot be created or destroyed
questions.explanation: Forces come in pairs of equal size acting in opposite directions on two bodies.

questions.text: What is the SI unit of frequency?
questions.explanation: One hertz is one cycle per second.

questions.text: What is absolute zero in degrees Celsius?
questions.explanation: Absolute zero, 0 K, equals −273.15 °C.

questions.text: Which formula gives momentum?
questions.explanation: Momentum is mass times velocity.

questions.text: What is the SI unit of electric charge?
questions.explanation: One coulomb is the charge moved by 1 A in 1 s.

questions.text: Which formula gives gravitational potential energy near the Earth?
questions.explanation: Lifting mass m by height h stores energy m g h.

questions.text: Which particle has a negative electric charge?
questions.explanation: Electrons are negative, protons positive, neutrons and photons neutral.

questions.text: What is the bending of light as it passes from air into water called?
questions.explanation: Light changes speed in a new medium, which bends its path.

questions.text: How is work calculated?
choices: Force × distance moved in the direction of the force
questions.explanation: Work W = F · d when the force acts along the motion.

questions.text: What is pressure?
questions.explanation: p = F / A, measured in pascals; mass divided by volume is density.
